host: Windows 11, AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (OpenGL Compatibility used for the asset captures)
scope: Removed the blue gun-oil can that the sniper set carries on the barrel; kept the rest of the set intact.

change.rule: An island of the fp_sniper 'Rifle' surface counts as the can when at least a third of its vertices sample a clearly blue base-colour texel (B-(R+G)/2 > 0.10) and its centre lies forward of the receiver (z > 0.10). Its triangles are dropped from the index buffer only, so the glTF skin bindings stay valid.
change.why_not_a_mean: Averaging the island hides the can (the label shares the atlas with the barrel rail), and thresholding the average also catches neutral gunmetal: islands of the ACR measure up to 0.015 from their own compressed texture.
change.third_person: assets/viewmodels/world_fp_sniper.res rebaked with tests/bake_world_weapons.gd --weapons=2 (19344 triangles, 3 surfaces).

test_hygiene: tests/functional.gd now pins settings.mode='tdm' and settings.classes=[] before start_match(); a saved preference (domination and edited class loadouts) previously made four of its checks fail on any machine whose user:// settings had been changed by playing the game.

playability_smoke.result: Real main.tscn match: ACR shot consumed 1 round, sniper shot consumed 1 round, 30 physics ticks of held W moved the player 2.14 m. play-weapon-0.png, play-weapon-0-ads.png, play-weapon-2.png, play-weapon-2-ads.png and play-move.png show the HUD, minimap, muzzle flash, ejected case and correct ammo counters.

evidence: before-right.png / before-top.png - unmodified sniper set, blue can on the barrel
after-right.png / after-top.png - same pose after strip_foreign_part
play-weapon-2.png - the sniper in a real match, no can

hand_contact.method: Engine-baked skinned vertex positions (MeshInstance3D.bake_mesh_from_current_skeleton_pose) at the idle pose; distance from every arms vertex to the nearest weapon vertex, searched in a 2 cm grid.
hand_contact.result: Palms and fingers reach the weapon surface on all five first-person sets: closest palm vertices 0.2-4.4 mm, closest fingertip vertices 0.2-0.9 mm, with 155-1332 left-finger and 573-1332 right-finger vertices inside 10 mm. The hand-alignment defect is not present in the current assets.
hand_contact.note: Vertex distance is a contact measurement, not a judgement of finger shape: a finger can touch the mesh and still not read as a proper grip.

sniper_ads_is_intentional: The sniper viewmodel is hidden in ADS (fighter.gd: gun.visible = camera.current and not (Arsenal.scoped(weapon_id) and aiming and view.aim_blend > .98)) and hud.gd draws scope_overlay() instead. scope-overlay-ads.png is the real scoped view. A HUD-free ADS capture of this weapon therefore looks like an empty street; that is the design, not a broken viewmodel.
known_limits: The can body is gone (its 74-vertex cylinder, 0.024 x 0.024 x 0.197 m, plus its label straps - 540 triangles in total). What is left is UV bleed: 341 of the barrel's triangles sit over the label patch of the shared atlas, so isolated barrel triangles still sample blue. Removing them would thin the barrel, so they stay; the visible result is a few small dark marks, not the blue box that used to hang off the muzzle.
Finger shape and forearm deformation were not re-authored: this pass measured contact (see hand_contact) but did not rebuild the hand poses.
Captures are software/Compatibility-rendered frames; no hardware-GPU or gunfeel claim is made.
Windows export and the headless suites were run on this machine; the Linux build and CI were not re-run here.
The export templates are not installed on this machine, so no playable export was produced locally.
